title: The section functor of an etale morphism over a finite locally free base is an etale algebraic space

standard_prerequisites.name: Sections are immersions
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows sigma is a closed immersion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Etale permanence and open immersion
standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrade sigma to an open immersion.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite part is algebraic
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that (W/U)_fin is an etale algebraic space.

standard_prerequisites.name: Where-isomorphism locus
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies F as an open of the finite part.

standard_prerequisites.name: Bootstrap
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes algebraicity of F in the general case.

core_obligations: Separated case: realize sigma as an open subspace Z_sigma with Z_sigma -> Z_{U'} an isomorphism, inject F into (W/U)_fin, and identify F as the where-isomorphism locus, an open immersion.
General case: take a separated etale cover W' -> W, use the first paragraph for F'' = F' x_{F,xi} U', and descend the etale surjective transformation F' -> F through Bootstrap.
proof_roadmap: Run the separated case by functor injection into the finite part plus the where-isomorphism locus, then descend through an etale cover with the Bootstrap theorem.
difficulty_reason: Two genuinely different arguments (functor injection + open-locus identification; then descent through a cover) chained together.
